message: Operation requires auth, but no auth is defined: Fern does not support any of the security schemes in its `security`: digest (http digest), mtls (mutualTLS). Fern supports apiKey in a header, http bearer, http basic, oauth2 and openIdConnect security schemes.

Operation requires auth, but no auth is defined: Fern does not support any of the security schemes in its `security`: brokenOauth (oauth2 without flows). Fern supports apiKey in a header, http bearer, http basic, oauth2 and openIdConnect security schemes.

Operation requires auth, but no auth is defined: Fern does not support any of the security schemes in its `security`: queryKey (apiKey in query). Fern supports apiKey in a header, http bearer, http basic, oauth2 and openIdConnect security schemes.
